proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11616 viṃśati gives Gujarati/Marathi vīs, Punjabi/Lahnda vīh and regional bīs. The western survey βis forms preserve the labial fricative; βih/βihi/vihi/vĩhi/vih̃i match the h-final series with final vowel and nasalization retained. These local forms are linked to the numeral family without settling internal Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: vihi.
